answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 18 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in summit, verified in ferrous, and prism names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. A 271 account operation therefore ties up 33 million dollars of idle capital. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
